remaining_concerns: The curated set still relies on several official or primary-government records for policy implementation and intent, so some claims are better read as administrative direction than realized outcomes.
Several 2022 macro indicators are only partially attributable to Biden because they are confounded by inherited pandemic recovery, private-sector behavior, and Federal Reserve tightening.
A few high-value items are prospective or post-period oversight pieces, so they help interpret direction and control quality more than they measure 2022 delivery directly.
